description: The apps talk to Ollama on its native /api/chat (never the OpenAI-compatible /v1, which takes no num_ctx), and send each request a num_ctx sized to hold it: ceil(prompt code points / chars_per_token) + max_tokens + template_tokens, rounded up to a power of two (each new num_ctx reloads the model, so few sizes are used), at least min_num_ctx and at most max_num_ctx. chars_per_token is a low guess, so the estimate errs large. Every request also sends truncate:false and shift:false: a prompt that still does not fit is a 400 naming both sizes, never cut in the middle without a word (Ollama's default, measured on Ollama 0.40.14: 514 of 3022 prompt tokens read, HTTP 200). The desktop sends a task's configured context_window instead (llm/providers/ollama.py). Issue #760.

cases.name: an empty prompt gets the floor
a scoring window and its prompt
one code point over the floor rounds up a whole size
a citation window with a long answer
beyond any model is capped; Ollama then refuses it
